# Version 4.151.0
> **Graphite GPU backend and performance** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ships the new Graphite GPU backend, async pixel read-back, and a wave of managed-code performance improvements. This release adds Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn — the next-generation Skia rendering engine. It also adds an async `RequestReadPixels` API, a new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` helper package, FreeType font support on Nano Server, and numerous zero-allocation performance wins across text shaping, color conversion, and data I/O.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded to milestone m151 with multiple upstream bug-fix syncs** — The engine was updated to Skia m151, and several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability and correctness fixes were applied throughout the release cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))
- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — The new next-generation Skia GPU renderer (Graphite) is now accessible from C# via new backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling GPU-accelerated rendering on modern pipeline APIs. ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **CPU raster regression from m151 restored** — `SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT` was re-enabled to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced by the m151 upgrade. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **WASM updated to Emscripten 5.0.6 with new exception-handling model** — WASM native builds now use Emscripten 5.0.6 with the new `exnref` exception-handling scheme, and static libraries for .NET 11 are included. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## API Surface

- **Async `RequestReadPixels` added to `SKImage` and `SKSurface`** — A new backend-neutral `RequestReadPixels` method allows asynchronous pixel read-back from GPU surfaces without blocking the render thread. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package with Vulkan tests on Android and Linux** — A new helper NuGet package wires up SkiaSharp's Vulkan backend to Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings. Vulkan integration tests now run on Android and Linux CI. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server, which lacks the Win32 GDI font stack, now falls back to FreeType for font loading and measurement. ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — New Docker-based CI legs exercise SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server, catching platform-specific issues early. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Binding generation made deterministic across platforms** — The binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the host OS, removing spurious diffs in generated files during cross-platform development. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in `SKRegion.SpanIterator` fixed** — The underlying `SKRegion` was not kept alive during iteration, causing intermittent use-after-free crashes. The region is now rooted for the lifetime of the iterator. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Native use-after-free in `SKPixmap.ExtractSubset` and `With*` fixed** — The pixel-data source object was not rooted across calls to `ExtractSubset` and the `With*` helper methods, leading to potential memory corruption. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in `SKImage.Create` failure path fixed** — When the native `sk_image_new_raster` call failed, the already-allocated CoTaskMem pixel buffer was never freed. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Native resource leak in `SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI)` fixed** — A native handle was leaked when the optional `SKRectI` crop overload was used. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Unnecessary `unsafe` modifier removed from `GRContextOptions`** — The `GRContextOptions` class carried an unneeded `unsafe` modifier that could trigger CA warnings in consumer projects. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Solutions migrated from `.sln` to `.slnx` format** — All Visual Studio solution files have been converted to the new `.slnx` XML format, reducing merge conflicts and improving solution-load times. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKColor ↔ SKColorF conversion ported to managed math — no P/Invoke** — Color conversion between `SKColor` and `SKColorF` is now pure managed arithmetic, eliminating a per-call P/Invoke round-trip. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370))
- **SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply ported to managed integer math** — Single-value pre-/un-premultiply operations now run as managed integer math, removing P/Invoke overhead on the hot path. ([#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **SKColor hex parsing optimized; `ReadOnlySpan<char>` overloads added** — `SKColor.Parse` and `TryParse` now use `ReadOnlySpan<char>` internally and expose span overloads, enabling allocation-free parsing from string slices. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **Allocation-free HarfBuzz text shaping and tag parsing** — `Buffer.AddUtf8` uses a pooled UTF-8 encoder, SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans, and `Tag.Parse`/`SKFourByteTag.Parse` no longer allocate a temporary array per call. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))
- **`SKData.SaveTo` and text-encoding hot paths optimized** — `SKData.SaveTo` now writes directly from native memory, `GetEncodedText` avoids an intermediate string allocation, `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` pre-sizes its lookup map, and `HandleDictionary` caches the skip-registration reflection check. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release with performance improvements: `Buffer.AddUtf8(string)` is now allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encoder, and `Tag.Parse` no longer allocates a temporary array per call.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

The release candidate applied the final round of m151 upstream fixes, landed the WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 native libraries, fixed the CPU raster regression, resolved two use-after-free memory bugs, and closed out performance work on HarfBuzz and color conversion.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 introduced the Graphite GPU backend bindings, async RequestReadPixels, the Silk.NET Vulkan package, containerized test infrastructure, SKColor span overloads, and the zero-copy SKShaper and SKData performance improvements.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (July 2, 2026)

Preview 1 updated the engine to Skia m151, added FreeType on Nano Server, migrated solutions to .slnx, ported SKColor conversion to managed math, and began the SKRegion and SKPixmap use-after-free fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.150.1...v4.151.0-preview.1.1)
